text:
maya: Heads-up: Monday night pick-up soccer watch outside HQ? Thinking curbside on 3rd floor balcony, 6:30pm. Bring snacks. Also quick fantasy ask — anyone want to swap goalies for tonight? My GK is on bench.
raj: I'm down. I'll bring a thermos of chili and paper bowls :bowl_with_spoon:.
ollie: Chili sounds great but I'm allergic to peppers. Can I bribe you for slices of focaccia instead? :pleading_face:
tess: Pizza + chili debate incoming. I'll bring napkins and a folding table.
chris: I'm in for the goalie swap. Offering my GK (A. Martinez) for Maya's (bench) — 1-for-1 straight-up. Thoughts?
maya: @chris tagging the roster: my bench GK is Ignacio (injury-prone but cheap). If anyone will take a gamble. Also prefer pizza over chili if there's a no-pepper option.
raj: Deal on the swap? I'll take the swap if someone covers chili to go vegetarian. Or I can make two pots: one spicy, one mild.
ollie: Can we do a 3-option poll? :thumbsup: Pizza :1st_place_medal: Chili :soccer: Both :shrug:
tess: Poll: Pizza / Chili / Both — vote by replying below. I'll tally at 5pm.
chris: Vote: Pizza
maya: Vote: Both (pizza for ollie, mild chili for me)
raj: Vote: Chili (but I'll do mild if people insist)
ollie: Vote: Pizza
lunch-bot: New poll created by tess: "Tonight's watch food" — Pizza:2, Chili:1, Both:1. Poll closes 17:00.
maya: Good enough. @raj bring mild chili, @tess table, @ollie focaccia. @chris DM me about the GK swap and we can do a quick lineup trade: 
```
Trade proposal:
- I give Ignacio (bench GK)
- You give A. Martinez (starter GK)
- No draft picks
```
maya: Also will live-stream on the little projector. Bring a chair if you want one.
raj: I'll bring a couple of folding chairs and a can opener. See y'all at 6:20.
tess: Adding to calendar invite now. :calendar:
ollie: Tiny reminder: bring cash for the slice fund ($3 suggested). Any volunteers to collect?
chris: I'll collect. :raised_hand:
maya: Perfect. See you tonight! :soccer: :pizza:
